title: EA is now a private company
summary:
Electronic Arts has officially become a private company. Last September, EA announced that an investor group led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners would be taking the company private in a $55 billion deal, and on Tuesday, EA said the deal successfully closed. The PIF will reportedly own 93.4 percent of the new company.
The deal includes $20 billion of debt financing - making it the largest leveraged buyout ever - which could mean big changes at EA

Under activity based funding, the 2025-26 National Efficient Price is $7,258 per NWAU(25), a 5.9% increase and the largest since national ABF began. A tonsillectomy is 0.7421 NWAU, about $5,386. A hip replacement at minor complexity is 4.0251 NWAU, about $29,214. Miss an additional diagnosis that shifts complexity level and you have moved five figures on a single episode.
